famSingleChild: Mnye kuphela umfundi ekhaya? I-Individual yi-{price} ngenyanga. Ngokongeza kancinci, i-Family yongeza ukuya kutsho kubantwana aba-5.

partnersCalcNote: Uqikelelo olusekelwe kwisicwangciso se-Individual nezinga le-25%. Abathengi abahlawula ngonyaka, abe-Family nabe-Schools bayalunyusa.
helpSwitchA1: Vula iphepha leAkhawunti yakho uze ucofe "Tshintshela kwi-Family". Umrhumo wakho wangoku uhlaziywa kwikhadi elifanayo, ngaphandle kokuphinda ulifake.
helpSwitchA2: I-Stripe ibala umahluko ngeentsuku ezisele kwixesha langoku, ngoko uhlawula umahluko kuphela.
helpChargeA1: Iintlawulo zivela njenge-GADIT okanye i-GADIT.APP. I-Individual yi-$3.99 ngenyanga okanye i-$39.99 ngonyaka, kwaye i-Family yi-$5.99 ngenyanga okanye i-$59 ngonyaka. E-Israel intlawulo yenziwa ngeeshekele: ₪14.90 okanye ₪149 ye-Individual, ₪19.90 okanye ₪199 ye-Family. Imirhumo eyaqala ngaphambi kuka-Okthobha 2026 igcina ixabiso eyaqala ngalo. Ukuba isixa asihambelani, sisenokuba sivela kwenye inkonzo.
helpCompareQ: Yintoni umahluko phakathi kwe-Basic, Individual ne-Family?
helpCompareA1: I-Basic (simahla): ukuya kutsho kukhangelo lwamagama oluli-10 ngosuku, zonke iintsingiselo, imizekelo, Izaci namabinzana, Imvelaphi yegama, neNcwadi yamagama enamagama ukuya kutsho kuma-30.
helpCompareA2: Individual ($3.99 a month or $39.99 a year, ₪14.90 or ₪149 in Israel): umntu omnye, zonke izixhobo. Ukukhangela okungenamda, umfanekiso kwintsingiselo nganye, intsingiselo echanekileyo kwisivakalisi, Every Word, Say it, yenza isivakalisi uze ufumane ingxelo, izivakalisi zemizekelo ezingakumbi nemibuzo ngegama ngalinye, ilizwi lendalo lokufunda ngokuvakalayo, ukusetyenziswa ngaphandle kwe-intanethi, imidlalo, iikhwizi namadabi amagama, nokuziqhelanisa ngobukrelekrele kunye nokulungiselela uvavanyo nedikteshini.
helpCompareA3: I-Family ($5.99 ngenyanga okanye $59 ngonyaka, ₪19.90 okanye ₪199 e-Israel): yonke into ekwi-Individual kubantwana ukuya kutsho kwaba-5 nabazali bobabini, kunye neMo yabantwana, indawo yomntwana ngamnye eyeyakhe, ibhodi yomzali enezaziso zamagama, noPelo.

remBody:
Molo {name},

Uvavanyo lwakho lwasimahla lwe-Gadit luphela ngomhla {date}.

## Kwenzeka ntoni emva koko
Ngaloo mhla ikhadi lakho liza kuhlawuliswa {amount} {cycle} nge-{plan}.

Akukho nto ufuna ukuyenza ukuze uqhubeke.

## Indlela yokurhoxisa
Unokurhoxisa nanini na ngaphambi komhla {date} kwaye akuyi kuhlawuliswa nto.

1. Vula [iphepha lakho leakhawunti](/account).
2. Cofa "Lawula iintlawulo".
3. Kwiphepha elivulekayo, khetha ukurhoxisa umrhumo.
pupBody:
Molo {name},

Enkosi ngokusebenzisa i-Gadit kwi-Android.

Iakhawunti yakho okwangoku ikwisicwangciso se-Basic.

Unokufumana zonke izixhobo ngezicwangciso ze-Individual ne-Family.

## Family

Yabazali nabantwana.

Ukuya kutsho kubantwana aba-5, ngamnye eneNcwadi yakhe yamagama, iMo yabantwana nebhodi yomzali.

## Individual

Yomntu omnye.

Ukhangelo olungenamda nazo zonke izixhobo.

Zombini ziqala ngeentsuku ezili-14 simahla.

Unokurhoxisa nanini na ngaphambi kokuba uvavanyo luphele kwaye akuyi kuhlawuliswa nto.

Xa ubhalisile, i-app iza kuzihlaziya ngokwayo.

Ngena nje ngeakhawunti efanayo.
